# No Enemy

<!-- Generated by npm run records -- build. Edit production.json and canonical documents. -->

Status: **published**.

Published on YouTube; the director supplied the URL on 2026-11-21 (user-confirmed). A starship's computer stages a battle for its crew while its probe does the real work. Restarted in 9:16 portrait on 2026-11-20 with native Veo dialogue for the bridge crew, designed voices for the Reptile, Ship and Probe, voice-driven lamps on both craft, a three-cue score and a closing scene the director asked for. The director approved draft 6 and authorized its 4K finish on 2026-11-20, then found a uniform and hair mismatch on one shot in the Captain's quarters while uploading. Draft 7 replaces that shot with a take generated between a matched first and last frame; length, cut points and soundtrack timing are unchanged. The director judged a small remaining colour shift good enough for publication; v7-4k is the published master. The description recorded here is the text delivered with the master; the published page's text was not retrievable and is not asserted. Technical checks, approval, finishing authorization and publication are separate events; real-time listening is the director's and is not claimed by the agent. Archived 2026-11-21 under the standard retention: the 4K master, voices, score, effects, references, recipes, timelines, delivery records and QA are kept locally; the generated takes are in the private backup; native drafts, the unpublished draft 6 master, segment renders and derived mixes were removed.
